channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Fiscal storm is about to hit us
item.description: CBO forecasts rising federal debt toward 120% of GDP, forcing North Carolina to face higher borrowing costs, shrinking federal aid and painful trade-offs on Medicaid, roads and local services.

item.title: Crime, race, history and NC’s US Senate campaign
item.description: How NC Republicans’ “soft-on-crime” attacks on Roy Cooper in the US Senate race draw on the South’s history of racially charged crime politics, even as crime rates decline.

item.title: Vote Republican for lower taxes, limited government
item.description: Wilson County GOP chair urges Republicans to boost turnout in 2026 primaries and general election, saying low past turnout handed races to Democrats and that voting GOP supports lower taxes and limited government.

item.title: Our Opinion: Wilson County 911 dispatchers impress; Mecklenburg sheriff stumbles
item.description: Thumbs up to Wilson County 911 for earning accreditation; thumbs down to Mecklenburg County Sheriff Garry McFadden for not knowing the three branches of government.

item.title: No. 3 Duke continues ACC dominance over Syracuse with 101-64 blowout win
item.description: No. 3 Duke crushed Syracuse 101-64 for its 11th straight win over the Orange, shooting 62% from the field as Cameron Boozer and Isaiah Evans led a dominant ACC rout in Durham.

item.title: There's new momentum for early childhood education at WCC
item.description: Wilson Community College’s early childhood program adds new leadership, partnerships, dual-enrollment options and free Child Care Academies to strengthen Wilson County’s child care workforce.

item.title: 2 children cut when truck clips school bus mirrors
item.description: Two Gardners Elementary students got minor finger cuts when an unknown large vehicle clipped their school bus mirrors in rural Wilson County; the other 46 riders switched buses and no crash report will be filed.

item.title: Fire damages Wilson home, displaces occupants
item.description: Gas fire pit blamed for Wilson house fire that caused $125K in damage, heavily damaged attic and displaced two adults and their pet; no injuries reported.

item.title: Demolition crew starts tearing down Wilson Mall
item.description: Demolition of Wilson Mall begins, bringing an end to the longtime shopping hub.

item.title: 2 adults displaced in residential fire on Ward Boulevard
item.description: A Monday afternoon fire heavily damaged a Ward Boulevard home in Wilson, displacing two adults and causing an estimated $75,000 in losses.
